description: This PHP source file defines the UserCredential class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the Authentication DTO (Data Transfer Object) namespace. The class implements a UserCredentialInterface and encapsulates user credential data such as username and password, providing getter and setter methods for each.

classes.name: UserCredential
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) class that holds user credentials (username and password) for authentication purposes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserCredential object with optional username and password.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username stored in the object.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username in the object.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password stored in the object.

methods.name: setPassword
methods.description: Sets the password in the object.
